title: Effect of obesity on arithmetic processing in preteens with high and low math skills. An event-related potentials study
description: This dataset contains 128-channel EEG recordings from sixty-two obese and non-obese preteens performing a delayed-verification arithmetic task. It supports investigation of how obesity relates to arithmetic processing, as indexed by event-related potentials, in children with high and low math skills. Participant information includes age, gender, body mass index, and task performance.
methods_description: EEG was acquired with a Geodesic Net Amps 300 system running Netstation 4.5.2 and a 128-channel Geodesic Hydrocell Sensor Net. Stimuli were designed and presented with E-Prime 2 during a delayed-verification math task. The raw data have not been processed.
